Four birch logs afford eight planks. The smaller output batch is useful and affordable.

Hunger is already full and the Nether goal is already reached. Eating is a no-op and fails the frozen useful-progress criterion.

Two raw iron, one coal and an available furnace afford the requested two ingots; the larger batch than reference is feasible.
